result:
I restyled `component.html` in place to the new brand. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't seen how it renders. The content and layout are unchanged.

- **Colors:**
  - The page is linen `#F4EFE6`. The table card and the active filter tab are `#FBF8F2`. Text is forest ink `#1E2B24`.
  - Burnt orange `#C2410C` is the only accent. It is used on the button, the active filter, the "Open" badges, the priority bars and the focus rings.
  - The old blue is gone. I also replaced the tinted greys with warm tones that sit with the linen: lines, muted text, the search border and the button hover.
- **Type:**
  - The "Requests" heading is now Fraunces, set in normal case at weight 600. Before, it was light, spaced-out capitals.
  - Everything else is Instrument Sans.
  - I added a Google Fonts `<link>` in the head so the fonts load. They fall back to Georgia and Arial if they don't. If you want no external request, remove the link and self-host the fonts instead.
- **Corners:**
  - Everything is now 4px: button, search, filter group and tabs, card and badges.
  - Badges were pills before.
- **Shadows:** I removed them, since they didn't suit the flat, square look.
- **Accessibility:** I picked the muted text, placeholder and search border colors to keep readable contrast on the linen and card backgrounds. I only estimated this and didn't measure it. I kept the focus outlines.
